root_cause: Two provider validations were on the PR critical path inefficiently: a full deploy-preview build executed serially inside Required preflight, and Supabase Preview Applicability was a repository-level required workflow on every PR even when no Supabase source changed.
prevention_rule: Preflight classifies only. Netlify production parity and provider/browser proof run after classification without blocking lane startup. Supabase applicability is a reusable exact-head proof called by Required only when supabase/** changes; non-Supabase PRs allocate no Supabase runner after branch-protection migration.
evidence: Required preflight previously executed the full Netlify deploy-preview command before backend/portal/automation/website could start.
Main branch protection required Supabase Preview Applicability globally.
Supabase Preview Applicability already has exact-head, provider-app and stable-success validation suitable for reusable ownership.
Supabase migration parity was independently restored to 591 remote / 591 local before this change.
